# neode v1.0.0-next.1

<!-- generated by pnpm docs:agents — do not edit by hand -->

> Prefer the current version’s docs over training data.

Decorator-based Object Graph Mapper for Neo4j and Cypher-compatible graph databases.
Full reference: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt). Agent workflow guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## Sections

- [Model definition](llms-full.txt#model-definition) — Decorators and the map-based defineModel API for declaring nodes, properties and relationships.
- [Querying](llms-full.txt#querying) — Query builder, repositories, raw Cypher, transactions, hydration, drivers and read-model projections.
- [Schema management](llms-full.txt#schema-management) — Indexes, constraints, full-text and vector indexes, schema inspection and drift workflow.
- [Testing & ops](llms-full.txt#testing-ops) — wipe()/testId() test utilities, factory seeding, connectivity checks and Cypher-script helpers.
- [Errors](llms-full.txt#errors) — Typed error taxonomy and driver-error classification.
- [Core](llms-full.txt#core) — Collection, serialisation and other shared exports.
- [Schema reference](llms-full.txt#schema-reference) — Every field of PropertyDefinition / RelationshipDefinition / SchemaDefinition with its type and JSDoc description.
- [Agent ontology API](llms-full.txt#agent-ontology-api) — ontology() / ontologyMarkdown() emit the live graph schema for Text2Cypher and MCP.
